abstain_reason: No driving. bd_overdamped_trapped is declared undriven: the fluid is at rest and nothing moves the trap, so there is no driving amount for this axis to bound. Abstaining is not being absent: this card is the record that the axis was asked and had nothing to constrain (P1).
